artistTagline: At Colors N Joy, we create handcrafted custom wall art that transforms ordinary walls into meaningful, statement spaces. Every artwork is thoughtfully designed to complement your interiors and reflect your unique style.
biography:
Meet the Artist

Aishwarya Dake
Artist & Founder

I believe the right artwork can transform how a space feels.

I personally conceptualize and oversee every Colors N Joy project, creating original, handcrafted artworks designed specifically for each space—considering its architecture, proportions, textures and light.


The Studio

Colors N Joy is an artist-led studio creating custom, handcrafted artworks for distinctive interiors. Every piece is thoughtfully developed to complement the space, its architecture, colours, textures and overall mood.


Creating Art That Gets Noticed




From handcrafted artworks to millions of online views, Colors N Joy continues to grow through art, design and a passionate community.




50M+ Views
Statement wall art reaching millions online.




50K+ Community
Growing across Instagram, Facebook & YouTube.


Pan India
Custom artworks created for homes and interiors across India.




100% Handcrafted
Every artwork is individually designed and created by hand.




Designed to be seen. Created to be remembered.


Our Services
Custom murals • Texture & Relief Art • Light-Integrated Wall Art • Canvas Art • Designer Art Clocks
